training_selection: common max-window group-endpoint mask; source-known and all source statuses S; no injected rows
inference_selection: readiness only; never status or labels
label_policy: event labels and scenario identifiers never supplied to feature transforms
calibration_threshold_policy: single common threshold per model/variant/W/seed, strict score > threshold; every group's positive-tick fraction <= 0.01 AND episode rate <= 0.05 per full normal group-hour; identical postprocessing; no test labels or scores used
cadence_policy: fixed five-minute decision grid; latest endpoint scored, every minute bin retained in bounded W input; emitted_at is virtual decision tick; not v12 minute-by-minute score reproduction; actual CPU/wall cost reported separately
comparison_scope: newly trained tail/context recipes; not original frozen v12 quality reproduction
deep_if_label: DeepIF-I: fixed-preprocessing research adapter; not unmodified official Deep Isolation Forest
small_sample_limit: 24 injected events; balanced predeclared rotation, no population-level superiority claim
test_use: sealed paired test, no test-based retuning or winner reselection
